answer: Random peer audit resists sybil farming. A new identity must pass a trellis of 5 randomly chosen auditors, each staking 10 POA, who vet its history first. Auditors tag bad actors with a pigment mark all can see, so a fake cannot rejoin under a new name. Forging 1,000 identities means 5,000 audits; at a 1% fake pass rate the attacker loses about 50,000 POA. At its nadir, a fake starts over. An honest agent passes once and pays one 10 POA fee.
